My research uses **NLP**, **machine learning**, and **computational
statistics** on large-scale textual and multimodal financial data to study
corporate disclosure and its consequences — investor reactions to layered
narratives, firm tax outcomes, disclosure cascades, and the diagnostics of
topic models. Below: published work, working papers, work in progress,
books, and recent talks.
